sources.summary: Dezeen Showroom: Australian design brand Fold Studio has released a series of freestanding folding screens comprising hardwood frames stretched with fabric or woven cord. Fold Studio founder and in-house designer Pauline Ollmann created the brand's Woven-Fold and Fabric-Fold collections, which share American White Oak, American Black Walnut or American Ash frames and raw brass hinges.
